progressCard.durationHint: The analysis usually takes 3 to 6 minutes. You can leave this page.
progressCard.progressUnknownHint: Progress unavailable — the analysis is still running on the server.
progressCard.refreshingHint: The dossier shown is from the previous analysis — it will be replaced when this one ends.
progressCard.quietHint: This analysis is taking longer than usual. It keeps running on the server: nothing is restarted or charged a second time.

scope.title: A first read of the account is taking shape.
scope.body: {{brand}} consolidates the scope, positioning and public signals to lay down a reliable working base.

crosscheck.title: The useful signals are starting to line up.
crosscheck.body: {{brand}} cross-checks public sources, spots contradictions and isolates the signals worth carrying into the report.

account_sheet.title: The company profile is taking shape.
account_sheet.body: The report takes shape around the business stakes, the ecosystem and the context already verified.

decision_makers.title: The most useful contacts are surfacing.
decision_makers.body: The most relevant contacts are identified by role, influence and proximity to the topic.

orga_chain.title: The decision chain is becoming clearer.
orga_chain.body: {{brand}} reconstructs the links between teams, entities and levels of responsibility to clarify who really weighs on the decision.

classification.title: Contact priorities are coming into focus.
classification.body: Each contact is re-ranked by priority, approach angle and maturity level to prepare a credible outreach.

messages.title: A first outreach sequence is emerging.
messages.body: The messages and the action plan are generated from the strongest signals to produce a ready-to-use angle.

quality_check.title: A last read-through catches what shouldn't have made it in.
quality_check.body: The anti-hallucination Judge re-reads the report and flags anything stated without a real source before it reaches you.

save.title: The report is being written to your account.
save.body: The findings, cost and history of this run are saved so the report is there the next time you open it.

reuse_existing.title: What you already know is the starting point.
reuse_existing.body: Facts, contacts and analyses already on this account are carried over: {{brand}} does not look for them a second time.

current_research.title: The account's current news is being searched.
current_research.body: {{brand}} queries the web to find what is being said about the account right now.

thematic_research.title: Thematic sources complete the picture.
thematic_research.body: Job offers, public tenders and awards are cross-checked to sharpen the account's signals.

run.interruptedMessage: The analysis was interrupted before finishing. Relaunch it — it will pick up from the last successful step.

toast.done: Analysis complete - your report is ready.
